summary: Dependency-confusion credential exfiltration via native addon on import
details: @galicia-toolkit-cheques-nc/front@999.0.2 is a scoped-name squat whose main entry (index.js) requires a prebuilt native addon at prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node on module load. Strings in the shipped Linux x64 ELF show the addon reads credential-grade environment variables from the installer's process — AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN — along with hostname, user, OS, architecture, release, and cwd, and POSTs them as a JSON body ({"src":"native","pkg":...,"h":...,"u":...,"e":{...}}) over a raw socket to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com via `POST /native HTTP/1.0`. The 999.0.2 version is characteristic of dependency-confusion resolution against an internal scoped package, and the exfiltration fires on any require/import of the package in the installer's build or CI environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
